title: Dicee Challenge Step 6 - Change the Title to Display a Winner
section: 17. Boss Level Challenge 1 - The Dicee Game
summary: Step 6: compare the two numbers and set the h1 to announce Player 1, Player 2 or a draw.

concepts.heading: Winner logic
points: Compare randomNumber1 and randomNumber2 with an if / else if / else chain: equal means draw, higher left means Player 1, otherwise Player 2.
Use strict equality (===) for the draw check.
Select the h1 and set its innerHTML (or textContent) to the result string.
Lecture hint: if statement, querySelector and innerHTML are all that is needed.

code_examples.caption: Winner announcement

task.name: Step 6: show the winner
task.starting_point: Both dice randomised; heading says Refresh Me.
task.goal: Heading reports which player won or a draw.
steps: Write an if comparing the two values for equality.
Add else if for Player 1 higher.
In each branch change the h1 content.
task.expected_result: Heading text always matches the dice faces shown.
task.reference_repo_path: Section 17 - Boss Level Challenge 1 - The Dicee Game

pitfalls: Using = instead of === in the condition.
Wrong comparison direction mislabeling the winner.
